text:
nora_cs: Heads-up: Solara onboarding showing an unexpected token surge overnight (~3.4x). Embeddings dominating traffic. Need quick guardrails + one-slide QBR note.
dan_finops: Yikes. Can you grab route split and a 7-day projection at this rate?
raj_se: Quick console snapshot: /v1/embeddings == 80% of tokens. Current ~1.6M tokens/day -> 7d ~11.2M. Looks like their nightly full-index ran with dense queries.
nora_cs: Immediate asks: 1) temp credit cushion + alerts, 2) soft throttle on embeddings route, 3) flip indexer to snapshot/cached mode if possible, 4) schedule 30-min enablement AM PT.
dan_finops: I'll provision a 20% buffer and set alerts at 70%/90% of cushion; will calculate token->$ delta for QBR slide.
lin_enable: I can run the enablement session. Plan: explain why reindex density matters, show batching + partial refresh patterns, present a caching TTL play. Morning PT ok?
raj_se: Mitigation plan: set soft cap /v1/embeddings -> 800k tokens/day, enable index snapshotting, add prefix caching. Implementing now.
sentry-bot: Created alert "solara-embed-cushion-70-90" (ID: S-2048). Conditions: usage >=70% of cushion; escalate at 90%.
sentry-bot: Playbook suggestion:
```
1) add 20% credit cushion
2) set soft cap: /v1/embeddings -> 800k tokens/day
3) enable snapshot cache for nightly indexer
4) schedule enablement + follow-up in 24h
```
nora_cs: Can someone draft one-line QBR bullet: root cause + mitigation + next step? Keep it short for the slide.
raj_se: Draft: "Root cause: full reindex produced dense embedding calls; Mitigation: snapshot cache + soft cap + enablement on batching; Next: monitor 24h and remove renewal flag if stable."
dan_finops: I'll add numbers: projected token reduction (~0.6M/day) and $ delta plus cushion math.
lin_enable: Will record the session and attach a 1-page playbook with batch-size examples and TTL defaults.
nora_cs: Assign owners: dan_finops -> cushion & slide (assigned), raj_se -> caps & cache (in progress), lin_enable -> enablement (scheduled). I'll reassess renewal risk in 24h.
raj_se: Implemented caps and enabled snapshot cache; watching metrics (reacted :thumbsup:).
dan_finops: Cushion provisioned; alerts live; added account note "temp cushion until follow-up".
sentry-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 24h (2798768878).
nora_cs: Thanks team. If mitigation holds, we'll include the playbook in the QBR packet and clear renewal flag.
